label: PowerEdge R760 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server whose base configuration ships with the 2x 1GbE LOM card and a dedicated 1G iDRAC9 port; the OCP 3.0 slot and up to eight PCIe slots are free for 10/25/100G adapters.

label: PowerEdge R660 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket rack server with 2x 1GbE on the LOM card plus a dedicated 1G iDRAC9 port in the base configuration, leaving the OCP 3.0 slot (up to 4 ports, 1G to 100G) and the PCIe slots for add-in networking.

label: PowerEdge T360 tower server
description: 4.5U-ish tower server for branch and SMB use with 2x 1GbE embedded on the planar LOM and a separate dedicated 1G iDRAC Ethernet port; optional PCIe network cards add 1G/10G ports.

label: HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen11 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server with no embedded networking: the standard configuration carries a Broadcom BCM5719 1Gb 4-port BASE-T OCP 3.0 adapter plus a dedicated 1G iLO 6 management port, and a second OCP 3.0 slot and up to 8 PCIe 5.0 slots stay free for 10/25/100G cards.

label: HPE ProLiant DL360 Gen11 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket rack server with no embedded networking: the default configuration populates OCP slot 2 with a Broadcom BCM5719 1Gb 4-port BASE-T OCP 3.0 adapter and adds a dedicated 1G iLO 6 management port, with the second OCP 3.0 slot and the PCIe 5.0 slots free for faster NICs.

label: ThinkSystem SR650 V3 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server whose base configuration has only the dedicated 1G RJ-45 XCC system management port; the dedicated OCP 3.0 SFF slot (rear or front) and up to 12 PCIe 5.0 slots are free for the 1G/10G/25G LOM and adapter cards.

label: SuperServer 6029P-WTR 2U rack server
description: 2U dual-socket WIO rack server with 2x 1GbE RJ45 LAN ports from the Intel C621 chipset and a separate dedicated RJ45 IPMI 2.0 port; the six PCIe 3.0 slots are free for 10G/25G add-in cards.

label: Synology RackStation RS1221+ 2U 8-bay NAS
description: 2U 8-bay rackmount NAS with 4x 1GbE RJ-45 LAN ports in the base configuration and a single PCIe 3.0 x8 slot free for a 10GbE or 25GbE network card; there is no dedicated management port, DSM is managed in-band.

label: QNAP TS-464 4-bay desktop NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with 2x 2.5GbE RJ-45 ports (2.5G/1G/100M) as standard and a PCIe slot for an optional 5G or 10G adapter; management is in-band over the same ports, with no dedicated management interface.

label: QNAP TS-673A 6-bay desktop NAS
description: 6-bay desktop NAS with 2x 2.5GbE RJ-45 ports out of the box and 10G/5G available only through the PCIe expansion slot; management runs in-band on the data ports, no dedicated management port.

label: ASUSTOR LOCKERSTOR 4 Gen2 (AS6704T) 4-bay NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with 2x 2.5-Gigabit RJ-45 Ethernet ports as standard and one PCIe 3.0 slot that can take an optional 10GbE card; management is in-band, there is no dedicated management port.

label: TerraMaster F4-424 Pro 4-bay NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with 2x RJ-45 2.5GbE network jacks and no 1GbE or 10GbE ports in the base configuration; it has no dedicated management port, so TOS is reached in-band over the 2.5G links.

label: TrueNAS Mini X+ 5+2 bay NAS
description: 5+2 bay desktop/mini-tower NAS with 2x RJ-45 1/10GBase-T LAN ports as standard plus a dedicated RJ45 IPMI port for out-of-band hardware management; an optional 2x SFP+ 10G add-on card fits the spare slot.
